items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: DON BESTER OPENED IN THE BAKER HOTEL ACROSS THE STREET. He opened at the Baker across the street. AND THEN YOU GUYS CLOSED HIM OUT, BECAUSE NOBODY WANTED TO HEAR HIM AFTER THEY KNEW ABOUT YOUR BAND.

ctx.x: He was down there. But they had this band come in there and these guys obviously weren't up to it or they didn't care, because they only had the job for two weeks and Mr. E----called after the first 5 days and said I'm sorry, but you guys aren't worth a damn.
THERE WAS NO OTHER BAND AROUND THERE TO TAKE YOUR PLACE.
After they heard us, they started springing up, Troy Floyd and another guy.
